checked_obligation: Verify that failure of Player 2 for a fixed N is equivalent to a legal list with no subset sum in [200-N,200+N].
reason: By the game definition, Player 2 wins on a legal list exactly when some sublist has sum in the stated interval. Therefore a counterexample for fixed N is precisely a legal list for which no subset sum lies in that interval; the group-theoretic rule candidates are inapplicable.
